feature_source: Frozen learned selector recomputed on two-frame RGB observations recovered by replaying the original saved actions; state sequences match exactly, selector coordinates can differ by up to 0.5 native pixel
original_query_tracks: Saved during the K4 replay; no forecast recomputation
policy_upsampling: Exact saved 256 target pixel indices and per-parent counts, verified against the saved parent hash; targets retain their own XYZ and copy saved parent displacements

high_resolution_rendering.source: Native MuJoCo render of exact recorded query/success/baseline terminal states; original saved point coordinates and trajectories projected into the same external camera

feature_visualization.name: Ordinary all-pixel PCA with orthogonal display rotation
feature_visualization.input_preprocessing: Original L2-normalization of the frozen 8D pixel embeddings
feature_visualization.pca_fit: Unweighted centered covariance of all 65,536 pixels from the four selected external views
feature_visualization.retained_components: First three principal components; explained variance order retained separately
feature_visualization.allowed_display_change: Orthogonal rotation, including component sign and order choices, inside the same top-three-PC subspace
feature_visualization.rotation_selection: Learned group centroids and original query points score display separability; they never weight PCA or modify pixel colors
feature_visualization.rgb_mapping: One global per-channel linear min/max mapping over all pixels and all examples, followed by 8-bit quantization
